advancement.kill_dark_doppelganger.title: Dark Doppelganger Slayer
advancement.kill_dark_doppelganger.descr: Defeated the Dark Doppelganger. A reward awaits!
advancement.summon_dark_doppelganger.des: Use the summoning scroll to call forth the Dark Doppelganger.
spell.irons_spellbooks.doppel_portal.gui: Enter through a portal summoned in front of you to exit through another portal some blocks away.
orb.tooltip1: §5Your gaze completed its final puzzle. The illusion descended into reality because of your perception—this shadow core is the invitation you personally handed out, summoning the homage of ten thousand shadows.
orb.tooltip2: §8"What he aimed to hook wasn't your life, but the very thought of you choosing to step into this place. The trap was already complete—the moment you understood the concept of 'trap,' all possible vigilance had become the sweetest bait sustaining its operation."
